title: A rodostói emigráció és a nemzeti emlékezet (Exile & Historical Memory)
grammar: Remembering a Historical Figure: emléket állít

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain what happened to Rákóczi after the war and how he is remembered.
I can describe how a historical figure is remembered using sokan ... jelképének tekintik and emléket állít.
I can name Kelemen Mikes and his Letters from Turkey.
I can use eight new words about exile and historical memory.
